title: LLM-Assisted Software Migration: from Module-Level Transformation to Repository-Level Integration
abstract: arXiv:2611.29942v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Software migration adapts an existing implementation to a new language, version, API, framework, or platform while preserving its behavior. Large language models (LLMs) succeed on individual functions and modules, but this success does not readily carry over to entire repositories, particularly deployable applications. This survey reviews LLM-assisted migration from module-level transformation to repository-level integration, culminating in the delivery of complete applications. We analyze 96 sources---including 46 direct migration papers---across four perspectives: (1) supported software engineering activities, (2) model roles as editors or orchestrators, (3) orchestration workflows (agentless, single-agent, or multi-agent), and (4) enabling techniques including knowledge engineering, project context, environment feedback, and model adaptation. translated_title: LLM辅助的软件迁移：从模块级转换到仓库级集成
translated_abstract: 软件迁移是在保持原有行为的前提下，将现有实现适配到新的语言、版本、API、框架或平台。大型语言模型（LLM）在单个函数和模块上取得了成功，但这种成功并不能直接延伸到整个代码仓库，尤其是可部署的应用程序。本综述从模块级转换到仓库级集成、直至完整应用程序交付的全过程，对LLM辅助的软件迁移进行了回顾。我们从四个视角分析了96篇文献（其中包括46篇直接涉及迁移的论文）：（1）所支持的软件工程活动；（2）模型作为编辑器或编排者的角色；（3）编排工作流（无智能体、单智能体或多智能体）；（4）使能技术，包括知识工程、项目上下文、环境反馈和模型适配。随后，我们比较了相关的评估实践与基准测试。尽管46项研究中有30项的目标集中于……
tldr: 该综述通过分析96篇文献（含46篇直接迁移论文），从软件工程活动、模型角色、编排工作流和使能技术四个视角，系统梳理了LLM辅助软件迁移从模块级转换走向仓库级集成并交付完整应用的研究现状，并比较了现有评估实践与基准。
en_tdlr: This survey analyzes 96 sources (including 46 direct migration papers) across four perspectives—software engineering activities, model roles, orchestration workflows, and enabling techniques—to systematically chart the state of LLM-assisted software migration from module-level transformation to repository-level integration and complete application delivery, while comparing evaluation practices and benchmarks.
